digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Friday closed with concrete progress on Amazon Connect rollout readiness and a clear technical direction for SMS consent, while several operational follow-ups remain for next week. Monday starts with timecards and a CM-CoE review before a dense afternoon delivery block.

items.label: Finalized the Amazon Connect attorney training audience
items.detail: The final decision covered all 20 attorneys: five approved attorneys were enrolled, 14 remain excluded for the MVP, and one could not be enrolled because the person was already offboarded.

items.label: Cleared the SMS automation technical-impact question
items.detail: The technical review confirmed that the legacy opt-out checkbox does not affect the current project and that the Consent object remains the correct path for consent management.

items.label: Move the Amazon Connect rollout into execution
items.detail: The team is targeting an office-by-office start during the week of October 5. Confirm the remaining production-readiness work, office sequence, site support, and hands-on rollout cadence.

items.label: Lock Amazon Connect production ownership and support
items.detail: Confirm the dedicated Salesforce integration account and the internal support model, including the unresolved SaltClick scope and timing for Phase II follow-up.

items.label: Review the Supabase security alert
items.detail: Confirm the affected project and severity, then assign remediation or document why no immediate action is required.

items.label: Clear the overdue Rippling task
items.detail: A fresh alert still showed one overdue company task today. Complete it or reassign it before the new week begins.

items.label: Close the EOW and executive status narrative
items.detail: Capture the final Amazon Connect, CoE, intake, and IT-capacity updates so Monday's leadership work starts from the latest decisions.

items.label: Set the CoE backlog and intake path for Sprint 19
items.detail: Use Monday's CM-CoE project review to confirm the backlog, ownership handoffs, and the remaining classification question for Timetrack of Stage Completion.

items.label: Confirm the Attorney Review at Intake operating owner
items.detail: The operating owner has been narrowed to Christopher Vitagliano or Katie T. Confirm the choice so Jhara can schedule the kickoff against the October 15 deadline.

items.label: Clear the pending access approvals
items.detail: Decide Sara Rodriguez's Training Agenda access and review Armando's help desk request.

items.label: Set the delivery path for the new-client process intake
items.detail: Capture the confirmed scope, requirements, stakeholders, and next owner from today's scoping discussion, then decide whether the request is ready for planning or needs more discovery.

items.label: Salesforce Program Standup was cancelled
items.detail: The recurring standup was cancelled, with the Executive Status Report and SaltClick reports designated as inputs to Monday's program brief instead.

items.label: Amazon Connect rollout is targeting the week of October 5
items.detail: The rollout will begin one office at a time after the remaining production-readiness work, office sequencing, training, communications, and technical setup are completed.

items.label: The Consent object remains the SMS consent path
items.detail: The technical review found no conflict with the current SMS automation work, so the Consent object remains the approved enforcement approach.

items.label: 8:00 AM - Approve timecards and prepare for the week
items.detail: Monday opens with a protected administrative hour.

items.label: 10:00 AM - Phase 1 & 2 CM-CoE Projects Overview
items.detail: Review the current status of the Phase 1 and Phase 2 projects handled by CM-CoE.

items.label: 1:30-3:30 PM - Four-meeting delivery block
items.detail: Internal Comms Framework, BD Portfolio Review, Legal Request Tool pilot feedback, and the Maria 1:1 run back to back; prepare decisions and handoffs before lunch.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Amazon Connect implementation standup
items.detail: Close the day with the latest production-readiness, sequencing, and rollout follow-through.

items.label: Eugenia Barragán begins planned time off
items.detail: Her out-of-office period runs through October 1, so confirm coverage for intake and CoE decisions that cannot wait.
